title: Acute Acetaminophen Toxicity
triage_criteria: Patient presents with ingestion > 150 mg/kg or 7.5g within 24 hours, initial asymptomatic or mild nausea, toxic Rumack-Matthew nomogram. Requires evaluation according to clinical evidence guidelines.
escalation_action: Serum acetaminophen level at 4 hours post-ingestion, immediate IV or oral N-acetylcysteine (NAC) protocol before 8 hours post-ingestion.

title: Acute Panic Disorder Attack
triage_criteria: Patient presents with sudden hyperventilation, carpopedal spasm, derealization, fear of impending doom, normal cardiac troponin. Requires evaluation according to clinical evidence guidelines.
escalation_action: Structured diaphragmatic breathing coaching (4-7-8 method), reassure patient of benign nature, short-acting hydroxyzine or sublingual alprazolam if refractory.
